name: Cryptographic Hash Generator
shortDescription: Generate secure SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, and SHA-1 checksums locally.
privacyNotice: 100% Client-Side. Calculations use hardware-accelerated Web Crypto API in your browser without transmitting your input.

howToUse.text: Paste passwords, tokens, or plain text into the input field.
SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, and SHA-1 digests update simultaneously as you type.
Click the 'Copy' button beside any hash algorithm to copy the hex checksum.

features: Native Web Crypto API hardware acceleration
Simultaneous calculation of SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, and legacy SHA-1
Zero network traffic for maximum security with passwords or private tokens
limitations: Processes text strings in UTF-8 encoding
SHA-1 is provided for legacy checksum verification only and should not be used for new security designs

faqs.a: Because sensitive text or passwords never leave your machine, preventing interception by intermediate proxies or server logs.

faqs.q: Which hash algorithm should I use for modern applications?
faqs.a: SHA-256 and SHA-512 are current cryptographic industry standards for checksum integrity and signature verification.
